prompt: The incorporation of this company happened in the same year titled on Taylor Swift 5th studio album. It was incorporated by a man born in Setagaya, Tokyo, Japan that worked with the illustrator who largely designed the original 151 Pokémon.     What is “this company”?
answer:
The company is **Game Freak, Inc. (株式会社ゲームフリーク)**.

- Taylor Swift’s fifth studio album is **_1989_**, indicating the year **1989**.
- Game Freak was incorporated in **1989**.
- It was founded by **Satoshi Tajiri**, who was born in **Setagaya, Tokyo**, and **Ken Sugimori**, the illustrator and principal designer of many of the original 151 Pokémon.
